entities.summary: Nikolay Alexandrovich Bestuzhev was a Russian Navy officer, writer, inventor and portrait artist; associated with the Decembrist revolt. Nikolay Bestuzhev was a journalists & chroniclers from Saint Petersburg (1791-04-24, Saint Petersburg–1855-05-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
